results.evidence_quote: Spent the morning making maamoul with Hana and Tariq.
Eid preparations started today and the house was full.

Still thinking about the mansaf. The thing that keeps coming back to me is that she learned all of it here, in this kitchen, from watching me. Which means even if she's somewhere else, she carries it.
Spent the morning making maamoul with Hana and Tariq. They came over early, flour everywhere, the kitchen smelled like the house used to when Samira was alive.
